about: Which layer each .mjs file belongs to (ARCHITECTURE.md 2.1). Since P3 the layers are folders: a file in core/, make/, check/ or cli/ is of that layer, and a rule may not say otherwise. Outside them stay the entry points users and other projects import by path (src/index.mjs, the kit's one entry, re-exporting the folders; bin/smak.mjs), the kits and the mods' profiles (imported and loaded by path in the guides), and the examples. The most specific rule wins. test/00-architecture.mjs fails on a file no rule covers, on an import that points up, on a kit module no command, kit, MCP server, script, viewer, profile or example reaches, and on a game's name in the kit. 'example' may import anything. The game layer is gone: what was H9's left for its own project (h9-maps) in P3, with the generators (kept on the branch dormant/0.39-generators).

ratchet.why: 2026-11-10, p3-folders: 70926 -> 70926 (0): the layers made folders (core/, make/, check/, cli/), every file moved, no line added or removed. Before: 2026-11-10, p3-carve merged over P3: 70857 + 69 = 70926: 2026-11-10, p3-carve: 90747 -> 90816 (+69): the carve welds the outlines of a turned drawing (weldOutlines: an edge within a unit of a longer edge's line of another space is put on it, each corner where its lines cross), which the plaza's seams asked for (a wedge of rock 0.4 thick across the cells' door, a wall 0.6 thick between the Chalke and its court, 21 pairs of walls a hair apart, 2 to 8 ambiguous leaves a compile on the drawing alone (hlbsp varies run to run): 0, 0, 0, 0), sketchFrame (a drawing's turn as a frame), smak sketch printing each space only with --verbose; retired rockInPlan's merging of a sliver between two lines that should have been one (-14), which the weld makes needless. Then: 2026-11-10, p3-out merged over p3-battery: 70527 + 115 (the battery, net of lift.mjs, which both retired) = 70857 (measured). 2026-11-10, P3 (p3-out): 90747 -> 70527 (-20220), H9 and the generators leave. To the branch dormant/0.39-generators, where they are kept: levels/assembly (the generators: layout, massing, assemble, building, style, site, dress by rule, below, metro, terrain, roofs, shells, shapes, pieces, themes, styles, views, fronts; 16385 lines), levels/lib/art-kit.mjs, levels/tools (build-site, assemble, layout, navwalk, views, art-kit), levels/specs, levels/styles, levels/corpus, levels/rules, the generator notes, and src/maps/texture-recipe.mjs, src/mapbrushes.mjs, src/maps/lift.mjs (reached by nothing once the generators left). To the H9 project (h9-maps, its own repository): levels/rp (the RP checkers, plugins, data and their tests, as rp/; smak check rp is rp/check-rp.mjs there), levels/art (as art/), notes-h9 and the H9 studies (as notes/), profiles/specialists-roleplay.mjs (as rp/). profiles/specialists.mjs and mastersword.mjs, public mods' profiles, stay in make (the game layer is gone).
